data.title: Satya Nadella says he’s AGI-pilled now

content.basic: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella onstage at Microsoft Ignite. | Image: Microsoft / YouTube Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says he's AGI-pilled, at least when it comes to how AI might make startling changes to the structure of the economy and how politics might change because of it. "I am AGI-pilled in the sense that at an economy level, what is the political economy's organization around AGI?" he asked at a roundtable discussion following his Microsoft Ignite keynote at the Chase Center in San Francisco. data.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now

content.basic: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.
